errors.invalidType: This value has the wrong type.
errors.invalidTimezone: Enter a valid IANA time zone, e.g. Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh.
errors.rankRangeReversed: The lowest rank in the range must not be greater than the highest.
errors.rankRangeAboveMaxRank: The range must stay within ranks 1–{maxRank}.
errors.slotCountMismatch: List exactly {count} set types, one per set.
errors.milestoneCountMismatch: List exactly {count} relay milestones, one per leg.
errors.milestonesNotIncreasing: Each relay milestone must be higher than the one before it.
errors.setsPerPlayerReversed: The minimum sets per player must not exceed the maximum.
errors.groupHandicapTooLarge: The handicap cap must be below the set target ({target}).
errors.koHandicapTooLarge: The relay handicap cap must be below the final milestone ({target}).
errors.minPlayersTooLow: At least {minimum} players are needed to fill every set; raise this to {minimum} or more.

violations.SLOT_INCOMPLETE: Pick two different players for this set.
violations.NOT_PRESENT: This player is not checked in for this match.
violations.MIN_SETS: Every present player must play at least {minimum} set(s).
violations.MAX_SETS: A player may play at most {maximum} sets.
violations.CONSECUTIVE: A player cannot play two sets in a row.
violations.LOW_RANK_SLOT: Both players in a low-rank set must be rank {min}–{max}.
violations.HIGH_RANK_SLOT: Both players in a high-rank set must be rank {min}–{max}.
violations.COMPENSATION: With fewer players present than the opponent, the only rank-{rank} player must play at least {minimum} sets.
violations.MIN_PRESENT: At least {minimum} players must be present. Otherwise the team can be disqualified.
violations.SUB_RANK: A substitute must be within {tolerance} rank of the player they replace.

violations.SCORE_INVALID: Enter a whole number of 0 or more.
violations.SCORE_INCOMPLETE: Enter the score for both sides.
violations.SET_TARGET: Exactly one side must reach {target} and the other must be below it.
violations.BELOW_HANDICAP: The score cannot be below the {handicap} start points.
violations.LEG_MILESTONE: This leg ends when one side reaches {milestone}.
violations.LEG_DECREASING: Relay scores are cumulative and cannot drop below {previous}.

warnings.KO_CAP_REACHES_MILESTONE: The knock-out handicap cap ({cap}) reaches the first milestone ({milestone}), so a leg-1 handicap can decide that leg before it starts.

errors.NOT_IN_SEASON: This team has no matches this season.
errors.NO_NEXT_MATCH: This team has no knock-out match left to forfeit.
errors.GROUP_CLOSED: The group stage is closed, so the team can no longer be reinstated.
